object_context: Child of H4d1a. Fix a smooth projective family f:X->S, a rational Hodge-locus branch T through s0, and an already algebraic central complete-intersection witness Z0 in the Kloosterman source class. Test whether the first-order geometric obstruction to lifting Z0 along every tangent direction of T vanishes by an explicit incidence/flag-Hilbert preimage construction. This is a source-bound calibration of direct first-order witness lifting, not a root initial-algebraicity argument and not an all-order deformation theorem.
structural_coordinates: root scope remains rational Hodge classes on smooth projective complex varieties; this child starts with an already algebraic witness and cannot solve initial existence
active source class is a smooth degree-e hypersurface Y in P^{2k+1} containing a k-dimensional complete intersection Z of multidegree (d1,...,d_{k+1}) with 1<=di<e
write Z=(P1=...=P_{k+1}=0) and F=sum_i P_i Q_i for the hypersurface equation
Kloosterman identifies the tangent space to the Hodge locus at Y with the degree-e part I_e of I=(P_i,Q_i) in this source class
first-order pair deformation is an incidence/flag-Hilbert question: a base tangent deltaF lifts when deltaF=sum_i(P_i deltaQ_i+deltaP_i Q_i)
membership deltaF in I_e supplies exactly such degree-compatible coefficients deltaP_i and deltaQ_i
the direct lift argument does not use injectivity of the same semiregularity detector and therefore avoids the H4d1a same-detector no-go
the source complete-intersection cycle is semiregular; this positive control does not prove that direct branch annihilation is strictly weaker than full semiregularity
first-order dual-number lifting does not establish higher Artin-order lifting, formal algebraization, monodromy/global continuation, or arbitrary-cycle generality
a useful strict-weaker successor must exhibit nonzero Hodge-branch tangent directions with direct witness lifting while full semiregularity injectivity fails or is independently absent
equivalent_formulations: prove delta_1|_{T_{s0}T}=0 for the source-bound branch-to-obstruction map
prove T_{s0}T is contained in the image of the differential of the flag-Hilbert/incidence projection at (Y,Z)
for every Hodge tangent deltaF in I_e, find degree-compatible deltaP_i,deltaQ_i with deltaF=sum_i(P_i deltaQ_i+deltaP_i Q_i)
construct a dual-number pair Z_epsilon subset Y_epsilon with P_i(epsilon)=P_i+epsilon deltaP_i and F_epsilon=F+epsilon deltaF modulo epsilon^2
solved_analogues: Kloosterman 2021/2022 complete-intersection cycles on projective hypersurfaces, where the Hodge locus component equals the locus of hypersurfaces containing a complete intersection of the fixed multidegree and is smooth at the source point

Bruzzo-Montoya 2022 toric deformation-of-pairs setting, where under their hypotheses preservation of the (k,k) class under infinitesimal deformation is equivalent to the subvariety remaining algebraic and the Noether-Lefschetz locus is locally an irreducible Hilbert-scheme component
near_solved_analogues: Buchweitz-Flenner and Pridham semiregularity/reduced obstruction mechanisms, which annihilate obstruction images but do not by themselves supply the strict-weaker nonsemiregular control sought here

Movasati cubic-hypersurface examples where a selected triple may be rigid while the Hodge locus has positive dimension, a hostile control showing that Hodge tangent directions can exceed deformations of a chosen witness

method_transfers.method: identify the Hodge tangent space as I_e for I=(P_i,Q_i), then use ideal membership as an explicit preimage under the incidence differential
shared_structure: a fixed algebraic central witness inside a moving smooth projective hypersurface
an independently computed Hodge-preserving base tangent space
a geometric incidence space of pairs mapping to the base
required_assumptions: the witness has the complete-intersection form and source degree hypotheses
the tangent-space identification T_Hodge=I_e is used only at Kloosterman's stated source scope
coefficients in I_e have the degree constraints needed to interpret them as deltaP_i and deltaQ_i
disanalogies: arbitrary rational cycles need not admit complete-intersection generators P_i or a factorization F=sum P_iQ_i
the source cycle is semiregular, so this does not yet witness a strict weakening of semiregularity
first-order factorization does not automatically iterate through nonlinear higher Artin orders
method_transfers.repair_question: Can the same explicit incidence-preimage mechanism be found in a source-bound nonsemiregular family, or can one prove an obstruction showing why the strict-weaker calibration fails?

local infinitesimal equivalence does not itself solve higher-order algebraization or global continuation

the source's complete-intersection algebra cannot be transported to an arbitrary rational cycle without a witnessed representation map
first-order tangent surjectivity is weaker than all-order formal lifting
formal lifting is weaker than algebraization and global/monodromy-compatible propagation
all deformation-propagation results start from an algebraic central witness and leave the root Hodge initial-existence problem untouched

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A desired infinitesimal output velocity is feasible when it lies in the image of the actuator-to-output Jacobian. An explicit preimage certifies first-order reachability without requiring an observation map to be injective on all errors.
common_abstraction: desired base/Hodge tangent versus admissible pair-deformation tangent
source_to_target_mapping: desired output velocity -> deltaF in the Hodge tangent space
Jacobian image -> tangent image of the flag-Hilbert/incidence projection
feasible infinitesimal motion -> first-order lift of the witness
shared_constraints: the preimage must be constructed before declaring success
rank/image statements are local and first order
nonlinear finite motion can fail even when the Jacobian is surjective
disanalogies: algebraic deformation functors have obstruction theory beyond a linear Jacobian
higher Artin orders, algebraization, and monodromy have no automatic control-theory analogue
cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Replace same-detector faithfulness by an independently computed incidence-preimage certificate for each allowed first-order Hodge tangent.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: Verify the source tangent identity and explicit degree-compatible factorization in a published special family, then search separately for a nonsemiregular strict-weaker control and for higher-order obstruction survival.
cross_domain_analogies.provenance_note: Proposal compressor only; it supplies no Hodge theorem or transfer authority.

analogy_scan_notes: Retained only the Jacobian/image analogy because it distinguishes direct first-order geometric reachability from detector injectivity and makes the higher-order failure mode explicit.
